findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: quote_prices, quote_price_crossings, quote_status, quote_regime, quote_settlement, quote_pulse, quote_token_check, quote_movers, quote_alpaca, quote_anchors, quote_bridge_route, quote_changes, quote_stablecoin_fx, quote_address_check, quote_bridge_speed, quote_desk, quote_network, quote_convert_check, quote_persist_check · Private data: search_tokens, get_token, get_balance, get_supply, get_directory, get_portfolio, quote_token_check, quote_movers, quote_bridge_route · Public sink: quote_movers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: quote_prices, quote_price_crossings, quote_status, quote_regime, quote_settlement, quote_pulse, quote_token_check, quote_movers, quote_alpaca, quote_anchors, quote_bridge_route, quote_changes, quote_stablecoin_fx, quote_address_check, quote_bridge_speed, quote_desk, quote_network, quote_convert_check, quote_persist_check · Private data: search_tokens, get_token, get_balance, get_supply, get_directory, get_portfolio, quote_token_check, quote_movers, quote_bridge_route · Public sink: quote_movers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
